executive_summary: An exploration of India's remarkable natural and geological phenomena: Meghalaya's living root bridges (bio-engineered by Khasi tribes from Ficus elastica roots), Manipur's Keibul Lamjao floating park (phumdis), bioluminescent beaches, Ladakh's Magnetic Hill optical illusion, and Lonar Meteorite Crater Lake in Maharashtra.
